title: Channel B — push gateway (persistent TCP, framed JSON)
description: Realtime control/telemetry over a raw TCP socket to the getSockAddr ip:port. WIRE FRAMING (not expressible in JSON Schema): each message is UTF-8 JSON text followed by the 3-byte delimiter 0x23 0x09 0x23 ('#\t#') IN BOTH DIRECTIONS — the server MUST also terminate its frames with '#\t#' (no length prefix). CLOUD->DEVICE COMMANDS REQUIRE AN INTEGER 'encrypt' FIELD (see cloudCommand $def): encrypt:0 => data is a plaintext JSON object (no AES needed); encrypt:1 => data is base64(AES-128-ECB(json, session[:16])). A command with no 'encrypt' field is silently DROPPED. DEVICE->CLOUD 'data' is always PLAINTEXT JSON (device never encrypts). AES key = first 16 bytes of data.session from cleanPack/register. KEEPALIVE: device sends 21006 Ping; the server MUST pong (see ping_21006).

infoType.description: cloud message type code (distinct from EID_* bus ids)

connectionType.description: only value emitted by firmware is 1 (primary control connection)

encrypt.description: MANDATORY on cloud->device commands. 0 = data is a plaintext JSON object; 1 = data is base64(AES-128-ECB(json, session[:16])). Missing => frame dropped (msg['encrypt'].isInt() gate in FUN_00457f08).

reason.description: present on failures, e.g. 'invalid json format !!'

data.description: device->cloud: plaintext JSON object. cloud->device command: object when encrypt:0, base64-AES string when encrypt:1.

$comment: Per-infoType data shapes below (as $defs). Match on infoType then validate data.

ping_21006_deviceToCloud.description: KEEPALIVE Ping from the device: {"infoType":21006,"data":{}}. The server MUST pong or the device reconnects (heart_online_ld.cpp).

pong_21006_cloudToDevice.description: Server's pong reply. Receipt alone marks the device online (RecvPong/FUN_00457b30). Safe form: {"infoType":21006,"data":{}}; optional boolean 'isExistConnect' (app-online reflection). Confirm the pong infoType demux against one capture.

cloudCommand.description: Any cloud->device command MUST include integer 'encrypt'. Absence => dropped (FUN_00457f08 gate).

encrypt.description: 1 = data is base64(AES-128-ECB(json,session[:16])); ANY other integer (use 0) = data is a plaintext JSON object. Must be an integer or the frame is dropped.

data.description: plaintext object when encrypt!=1; base64-AES string when encrypt==1

lz4_len.description: length of the LZ4 stream inside 'map'

map.description: base64( LZ4_compress( width*height occupancy cells, row-major ) )

region.description: a room or forbidden zone; appears in map 'area[]' and in SetAreaTactics(21003)

forbidType.description: non-empty => forbidden/no-go zone rather than a room

startPos.description: index of first point in this chunk
